reason: Reviewed all five surfaces for the Codex trust-key fix. Lifecycle hooks: no hook definition or output changes. CLI readiness: codexTrustFindings now keys an unset CODEX_HOME by the logical ~/.codex, as Codex does (it canonicalizes only a set CODEX_HOME), so a symlinked ~/.codex no longer reports approved handlers as new in doctor, a refused ask or the send notice; the wording of every message is unchanged. The Stop and tool-hook fingerprints use the same key, so a session that already ran under the old key with a symlinked ~/.codex may need one fresh session. Notifai skill, harness setup and domain terms: unchanged. skills/guidance-changes.json carries one release note for this change.
